title: arch-diagram
summary: Draws one self-contained HTML layer diagram of a project's units by folder, with the layers measured from the uses clauses
intro: Read this when you want the shape of a project in one file you can open anywhere: which folder sits on which, and the uses lines behind every arrow. It needs no Graphviz and fetches nothing.

help: drag-lint arch-diagram       --db <db> [--output <file.html>] [--json]   (one self-contained HTML layer diagram of the units by folder; layers measured from uses; no Graphviz)

questions.ask: Which folder of this project sits on which?
Which uses lines make a folder depend on a folder above it?
